name: internal_reward
description: The epoch rewards a bank credited while it was prepared: the vote commission rewards of the first block of an epoch and the stake rewards of the partition blocks that follow, in the order they were credited

bank_seq.description: Bank sequence number of the bank that credited the rewards

is_leader.description: True if the bank is a block this validator is producing

rewards.description: Rewards credited, each one agave reward entry of the block

reward_type.description: agave RewardType: 3 staking, 4 voting, 5 deactivated stake

commission_bps.description: Commission of the vote account in basis points, UINT_MAX when agave records none

post_balance.description: Lamports of the account after the credit
